content:
The average rate of change of \(f\) over \([1,3]\) is
\[
\frac{f(3)-f(1)}{3-1}.
\]
From the graph, the points are \((1,-1)\) and \((3,4)\), so
\[
f(1)=-1,\qquad f(3)=4.
\]
Thus,
\[
\frac{4-(-1)}{3-1}=\frac{5}{2}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\text{The average rate of change over }[1,3]\text{ is }\frac{5}{2}=2.5.}
\]
